lines.text: Many learners say: She told to me a story.
Better: She told me a story.
Told me! She told me a story.

data.wrong: She told to me a story.

native.tip: हिंदी के “मुझसे कहा” की तरह to न जोड़ें; अंग्रेज़ी में सीधे “told me” बोलें।
native.caption: क्या आप भी कहते हैं “She told to me a story”? 😉 अंग्रेज़ी में “She told me a story” सही है, क्योंकि told के बाद सीधे व्यक्ति आता है, to नहीं। Carlos की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “told me”। to हटाकर “told me” बोलें। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: Do not add to like the Hindi “mujhse kaha”; in English say “told me”.
en.caption: Do you say “She told to me a story”? 😉 In English “She told me a story” is right, because told is followed straight by the person, no to. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
